title: GTA6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers: Pre-Order Guide and Details
description: Sony and Rockstar have teamed up for official GTA6 limited-edition PS5 controllers in black and white. Check out the pre-order details and release date.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers: Complete Pre-Order Guide

As the highly anticipated release date for Grand Theft Auto VI approaches, fans are looking for ways to fully gear up for the experience. According to recent reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, Sony and Rockstar Games have officially joined forces to offer two stunning PS5 limited-edition controllers themed around the upcoming blockbuster, with pre-orders now live in regions including the USA and the UK.

### Design and Aesthetic Details

Official limited-edition hardware is always a major highlight for collectors and hardcore fans. The GTA6-themed DualSense controllers feature a variety of custom design choices that capture the vibe of the game's setting:

* **Color Options**: Players can choose between a sleek black model or a clean white model.
* **Accent Panels**: Both controllers sport a striking blue and purple faceplate surrounding the thumbsticks and touchpad, evoking a vibrant aesthetic.
* **Branded Touchpad**: The official GTA6 logo is prominently printed directly onto the touchpad.
* **Textured Grips**: Both handles feature unique palm tree indentations, adding a subtle yet thematic tactile feel to your gaming sessions.

### Release Date and Availability

Both the black and white limited-edition controllers are scheduled to launch on the exact same day as the game itself: **19th November 2026**. This synchronized release ensures that players can unbox their new customized hardware right alongside their copy of the game.

Pre-order links for the USA and UK markets have been made available following the announcement. Given the immense popularity of the franchise, fans hoping to secure a controller ahead of the November launch are encouraged to act quickly before initial stocks deplete.

## Editor's Take

Merchandise for a title as monumental as GTA6 always commands massive attention, but custom hardware with thoughtful thematic touches—like the neon-style accents and palm tree grip details—elevates the appeal. Releasing these controllers on November 19, 2026, alongside the game allows fans to create the ultimate launch-day setup. For dedicated PlayStation 5 players, this collaboration offers a stylish way to dive into the next era of open-world gaming.
